I think this is a leftover of the original PoC of this devnet I agree that what we need is something on top of bogota-devnet-2 But I think we will keep devnets separated: Daisugi for experimenting aggregation, and whatever we do on top of bogota is done starting with no aggregation This is my understanding, could be wrong, but I think it's the best whati s the difference between these 2 networks ? Daisugi currently misses some of the latest bogota (Hegota devnet on the EL side) features That’s why at the beginning of this thread I suggested that we spec something for Daisugi on top of bogota-devnet-2 specs
